emma: opened PR to update SDK snippets: streaming + pagination + retries. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901
noah: quick scan — looks good but a few practical fixes before merge.
li: list?
noah: 1) TS still calls `client.stream()`; should be `client.chat.stream()` now.
noah: 2) Python retry doc mentions exponential backoff but no jitter example — risky for thundering clients.
noah: 3) pagination example doesn't show persisting resume token between restarts; customers will ask.
emma: agreed. keep snippets tiny and runnable. I'll update the migration blurb too (v1.3: chat APIs moved under client.chat.*, resume_token is opaque).
li: I can add a minimal Go example for file-backed resume token:
```
// read persisted token
b, _ := os.ReadFile("/tmp/ri_resume")
req.ResumeToken = string(b)
// after checkpoint
_ = os.WriteFile("/tmp/ri_resume", []byte(newTok), 0644)
```
li: that'll be <10 lines and copy-paste ready.
noah: For Python I'll add a compact jitter helper in the same code block:
```
import random, time

def jitter_backoff(attempt, base=0.4, cap=8):
    time.sleep(min(cap, base*(2**attempt)) + random.uniform(0, base))
```
noah: keeps it dependency-free and clear.
emma: TS fix: include AbortController + `for await (const chunk of stream)` and try/catch. Also ensure long lines are wrapped for the docs formatter.
li: I'll push Go snippet now.
doc-bot: lint:docs queued — will comment on PR when finished :gear:
noah: also add a short note: prefer server-side batching for strict no-duplicate semantics; otherwise use idempotent cursors and client-side checkpoints.
emma: plan: Li pushes Go, Noah updates Python & TS, I'll re-run lint and merge once clean. target EOD PT.
li: pushed Go change.
doc-bot: lint:docs completed — 0 errors, 1 warning (line-length). see PR comments.
noah: fixed long lines and pushed TS + Python jitter helper.
emma: all green for me. merging after squash. thanks!
li: LGTM :+1:
noah: :shipit:
